guide_page_title: Guide to Living in Karabük City
guide_page_desc: Everything students and parents need to know about the city, housing, and living conditions
guide_sec1_desc: A quiet and safe city located in northern Turkey, famous for its picturesque nature and proximity to historic Safranbolu.
guide_sec2_desc: Public, private, and shared student housing options are available at very affordable prices compared to major cities.
guide_sec3_desc: The city features various international and local restaurants, exchange offices, and direct transport services to campus.
guide_transport_desc: The city has an excellent transportation network connecting all neighborhoods to the university campus. Students enjoy large discounts using the Student Card.
testim_1_text: Honestly, NABU agency is the best team I've dealt with. They finished my admission papers for Karabük University very quickly and even picked me up from the airport. Hats off to you!
testim_2_text: My experience with them was really good. The housing they provided is close to the university and clean, but they took a little time to reply on WhatsApp because of the high volume.
testim_3_text: Thank you NABU team for everything! I was really scared about traveling alone, but they were with me step by step until I got my residency.
testim_4_text: The agency is highly respectable and their prices are much better than others. The university itself is excellent, but Karabük is a bit too quiet for people who like a busy lifestyle.
testim_5_text: Without NABU, I wouldn't have known how to handle the university papers. Translation, notarization, Highly recommended.
testim_6_text: The application was easy and simple, and their help in getting the transportation card and opening a bank account gave me peace of mind as soon as I arrived.
